title: The Solar Empress
subtitle: Flanking the center, a dramatic fan of marquise and pear-cut white diamonds radiates outward in a foliate garland motif — movement frozen in platinum. Two graduated rows of round brilliant diamonds complete the collar, sweeping the neck in a seamless arc of white light.
